questions.q: A General Ledger balance is tied to which combination of attributes?
options: Only the account and the amount
Ledger, account combination, period, currency, and balance type
Only the journal source and category
Only the preparer and approval status
questions.explain: Every balance is specific to a ledger, full account combination, period, currency, and balance type. Change any one and you get a different balance.

questions.q: Which balance type represents committed but not-yet-spent amounts, such as open purchase orders?
options: Encumbrance
Actual
Budget
Statistical
questions.explain: Encumbrance balances track commitments like purchase orders, central to budgetary control.

questions.q: Why does a year-to-date balance for an expense account reset at the start of a new fiscal year, while cash does not?
options: Expense accounts are deleted every year
Cash is the only account type General Ledger tracks YTD for
Expense accounts never have a YTD balance
Income statement accounts are measured per fiscal year; balance sheet accounts carry forward continuously
questions.explain: Balance sheet (asset/liability/equity) YTD balances carry forward; income statement (revenue/expense) YTD balances reset each fiscal year because they measure a year's activity.

options: A 3D chart used only in executive dashboards
A synonym for the chart of accounts
The pre-summarized, multidimensional structure that account inquiries and reports read from instead of re-scanning every journal line
A type of journal batch
questions.explain: The balances cube pre-aggregates posted activity by account, period, currency, and balance type so reporting is fast.

questions.q: Can actual, budget, and encumbrance balances exist for the same account combination and period at the same time?
options: Yes, all three can exist side by side, which is what enables budget-to-actual comparisons
No, only one balance type can exist per account per period
Only actual and budget can coexist, never encumbrance
Only in a secondary ledger
questions.explain: All three balance types can exist in parallel for the same account combination and period, enabling side-by-side comparison reports.
